text:
Tara (CS): Quick sync — Polaris Dedicated bring-up TOMORROW 05:30 UTC. Final checklist: quota, autoscale policy, load tests, KMS access, fallback to hosted. Who can own runbook step 3 (warm traffic ramp & canary)?

Kevin (Infra): I can take runbook step 3. We provisioned 10 reserved slots (A100-v4) in the pool; burst buffer = 2 nodes. Need to confirm slot-template and pool IDs for handoff.

Anya (SE): I'll run the canary tests. Proposed plan: 5% traffic for 20m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% cutover. Will need Polaris API keys + KMS unseal window before 05:15 UTC.

Oliver (SRE): Autoscale policy suggestion for initial rollout: target_util 60%, min_replicas 4, max_replicas 12, cool_down 120s. Also set request_queue_length_threshold = 1500 to avoid early scale-ups during the ramp.

Tara (CS): Polaris confirmed quota request in portal. @Kevin can you post infra IDs so CS doc can link directly? Also add explicit rollback steps (route back to hosted, kill reservations).

Kevin (Infra): Infra IDs: pool-id=pool-pol-7, slot-template=reserved-a100-v4-prod. Temporary host used for smoke: g4dn-xlarge. CLI warmup command below: 

Kevin (Infra): ```
# trigger warmup agent
redwoodctl capacity warm --pool pool-pol-7 --slots 10 --profile warm-ramp
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled job 1767777777-ldr created for 2026-03-23T05:30:00Z — loadtest will post updates to this thread when started.

Anya (SE): I'll kick the canary at 05:35 UTC (5m after warmup). I'll paste perf snapshots every 5m. Targets: p95 < 220ms, error_rate < 0.5%, token_cost within expected envelope.

Oliver (SRE): Prepare fallback model variant: quantized-v2 (lower throughput but lower mem). Add routing fallback: region=us-west -> fallback=hosted-quantized-v2, max-fallback-rate=20% during first 2h.

Tara (CS): Noted. Also customer requested a billing grace if warmup causes a one-time overage; I'll capture that in the handoff doc. @Kevin enable quota alerting to CS and Eng Oncall.

Kevin (Infra): Alerts created: quota-usage-pol@80% -> #customer-success, #eng-oncall. Added runbook link and rollback snippet to the reservation ticket.

Anya (SE): Final smoke command I'll use for the canary (will redact real key after):

Anya (SE): ```
curl -sS -X POST https://polaris.api/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": "quick smoke sample"}'
```

Tara (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll update the onboarding checklist and post the ops checklist link here once it's live. If anything blocks KMS unseal DM me.
